onboarding_cases_recruiting_case_workspa.name: onboarding_cases_recruiting_case_workspace_ck
onboarding_cases_recruiting_case_workspa.value: "onboarding_cases"."recruiting_case_id" IS NULL OR "onboarding_cases"."workspace_id" IS NOT NULL

recruiting_cases_stage_lifecycle_ck.name: recruiting_cases_stage_lifecycle_ck
recruiting_cases_stage_lifecycle_ck.value:
(
      ("recruiting_cases"."lifecycle" = 'active' AND "recruiting_cases"."stage" NOT IN ('hired_transferred_to_onboarding', 'closed_lost'))
      OR ("recruiting_cases"."lifecycle" = 'hired_transferred' AND "recruiting_cases"."stage" = 'hired_transferred_to_onboarding')
      OR ("recruiting_cases"."lifecycle" = 'closed_lost' AND "recruiting_cases"."stage" = 'closed_lost')
    )

recruiting_cases_active_fields_ck.name: recruiting_cases_active_fields_ck
recruiting_cases_active_fields_ck.value:
"recruiting_cases"."lifecycle" <> 'active' OR (
      "recruiting_cases"."task_owner_id" IS NOT NULL
      AND "recruiting_cases"."next_action" IS NOT NULL
      AND btrim("recruiting_cases"."next_action") <> ''
      AND "recruiting_cases"."next_action_due_at" IS NOT NULL
      AND "recruiting_cases"."sla_deadline_at" IS NOT NULL
    )

recruiting_cases_follow_up_fields_ck.name: recruiting_cases_follow_up_fields_ck
recruiting_cases_follow_up_fields_ck.value:
(
      "recruiting_cases"."stage" = 'future_follow_up'
      AND "recruiting_cases"."follow_up_due_at" IS NOT NULL
      AND "recruiting_cases"."resume_stage" IN (
        'new_lead', 'contact_attempted', 'connected_prequalified', 'application_sent',
        'application_received', 'manager_review', 'clearinghouse_pending',
        'drug_test_scheduled', 'drug_test_passed', 'compliance_documents_pending',
        'contract_sent', 'contract_signed', 'ready_for_onboarding'
      )
    )
    OR (
      "recruiting_cases"."stage" <> 'future_follow_up'
      AND "recruiting_cases"."follow_up_due_at" IS NULL
      AND "recruiting_cases"."resume_stage" IS NULL
    )

recruiting_cases_closed_lost_fields_ck.name: recruiting_cases_closed_lost_fields_ck
recruiting_cases_closed_lost_fields_ck.value:
(
      "recruiting_cases"."stage" = 'closed_lost'
      AND "recruiting_cases"."closed_lost_reason" IN (
        'qualification_not_met', 'clearinghouse_issue', 'drug_test_issue',
        'compliance_document_issue', 'contract_declined', 'compensation_or_role_mismatch',
        'withdrew', 'no_response', 'duplicate_or_merged', 'other'
      )
      AND (
        "recruiting_cases"."closed_lost_reason" <> 'other'
        OR ("recruiting_cases"."closed_lost_note" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("recruiting_cases"."closed_lost_note") <> '')
      )
    )
    OR (
      "recruiting_cases"."stage" <> 'closed_lost'
      AND "recruiting_cases"."closed_lost_reason" IS NULL
      AND "recruiting_cases"."closed_lost_note" IS NULL
    )

recruiting_cases_transfer_fields_ck.name: recruiting_cases_transfer_fields_ck
recruiting_cases_transfer_fields_ck.value:
(
      "recruiting_cases"."transfer_status" = 'not_requested'
      AND "recruiting_cases"."transfer_requested_at" IS NULL
      AND "recruiting_cases"."transferred_at" IS NULL
    )
    OR (
      "recruiting_cases"."transfer_status" = 'pending'
      AND "recruiting_cases"."transfer_requested_at" IS NOT NULL
      AND "recruiting_cases"."transferred_at" IS NULL
    )
    OR (
      "recruiting_cases"."transfer_status" = 'completed'
      AND "recruiting_cases"."transfer_requested_at" IS NOT NULL
      AND "recruiting_cases"."transferred_at" IS NOT NULL
    )
    OR (
      "recruiting_cases"."transfer_status" = 'failed'
      AND "recruiting_cases"."transfer_requested_at" IS NOT NULL
      AND "recruiting_cases"."transferred_at" IS NULL
    )

recruiting_onboarding_transfers_status_c.name: recruiting_onboarding_transfers_status_ck
recruiting_onboarding_transfers_status_c.value:
(
      "recruiting_onboarding_transfers"."status" = 'pending'
      AND "recruiting_onboarding_transfers"."onboarding_case_id" IS NULL
      AND "recruiting_onboarding_transfers"."completed_at" IS NULL
      AND "recruiting_onboarding_transfers"."failed_at" IS NULL
      AND "recruiting_onboarding_transfers"."failure_reason" IS NULL
    )
    OR (
      "recruiting_onboarding_transfers"."status" = 'completed'
      AND "recruiting_onboarding_transfers"."onboarding_case_id" IS NOT NULL
      AND "recruiting_onboarding_transfers"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL
      AND "recruiting_onboarding_transfers"."failed_at" IS NULL
      AND "recruiting_onboarding_transfers"."failure_reason" IS NULL
    )
    OR (
      "recruiting_onboarding_transfers"."status" = 'failed'
      AND "recruiting_onboarding_transfers"."onboarding_case_id" IS NULL
      AND "recruiting_onboarding_transfers"."completed_at" IS NULL
      AND "recruiting_onboarding_transfers"."failed_at" IS NOT NULL
      AND "recruiting_onboarding_transfers"."failure_reason" IS NOT NULL
      AND btrim("recruiting_onboarding_transfers"."failure_reason") <> ''
    )
